rv.q: It becomes immediately apparent why Elerian and Soleimanpour elected to hire stars for their production, as the nature of the play requires great confidence in the lead actor. One of the joys of theatre is the fleeting, ephemeral nature of a production, going to see a show once and knowing it will never be seen again in the same way.
All in all, White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a deeply moving and, at times, thrilling theatrical experiment.
